A few things you might be wondering.

What is Nookaa?+

Nookaa is a grab-and-go brand serving beverages only, with counter pickup and small, temporary seating for a brief stop.

How much do Nookaa beverages cost?+

Beverages range from ₹71 to ₹199. Prices are in INR and taxes are extra. Add-ons are priced separately; see our full menu for every item and price.

What cup sizes do you serve?+

Our hot beverages are served in 250 ml cups and cold beverages in 475 ml cups.

How does Nookaa work?+

Nookaa is a grab-and-go beverage brand. Walk up to our counter, choose your beverage, collect it and take it along. No reservation is needed.

Do you serve food or snacks?+

We serve beverages only. Explore coffees, matcha, teas, coolers and more on our menu.

Is seating available?+

Any seating at Nookaa is small and temporary, for a brief stop. Our outlets are designed for beverage pickup, rather than extended stays, working or studying.

Do you offer plant-based milk?+

Oat milk and almond milk are available as paid add-ons. See the menu for prices.

Can I take my beverage to go?+

Yes! That’s what Nookaa is made for. Pick up your beverage at the counter and take it wherever your day goes.

What can I find in the Nookaa app?+

Discover rewards, discounts and beverage subscriptions in the Nookaa app.
